patterns.note: Content is presented in a two-column layout where a narrow, fixed-width left column displays metadata (type, category, year) and a wide right column features the primary content title.

An extreme typographic scale is used, with primary content titles rendered in very large, bold sans-serif text, contrasting sharply with much smaller, lighter sans-serif text used for metadata and navigation.

A high-contrast color scheme dominates, featuring a black background with white text for primary content, subtle gray for secondary text, and a single vibrant blue as an accent for interactive elements.
The header navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to filters and site branding.

All content is presented as a continuous, vertically stacked list of entries, each maintaining the consistent two-column metadata and title structure without distinct section breaks beyond vertical spacing.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header navigation that remains visible at the top of the screen as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to filters and site navigation.

A stark typographic hierarchy is established using a single sans-serif font, where main content titles are rendered in a very large, heavy weight, while associated metadata is presented in a much smaller, lighter weight, creating clear visual distinction.
A high-contrast color scheme of black background, white primary text, and a single vibrant blue accent color is used to create a bold and modern aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold headings (~4-5x body text) with small, light metadata text, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical spacing between content entries and horizontal spacing between the metadata and main content columns.

standout: This site stands out with its extreme typographic scale and high-contrast black and white aesthetic, creating a bold, editorial feel. The presentation of content as a continuous, filterable archive list, rather than distinct sections, gives it a unique, almost data-driven yet artistic character.
